verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.wandb.ai and markdown versions of doc pages (weave.md) that point agents to the full documentation index. The official MCP server also gives AI assistants direct access to W&B documentation, and W&B Skills cover the Weave SDK for agents. missing for 10: a Weave-specific llms.txt (the file served is a CoreWeave-wide umbrella index, and one spec link it lists returns 404), independent corroboration of agents using the docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
